pr.title: KS-530: re-date the four audit-baseline rows Kam named to 2026-10-09
pr.body:
**Kam mailed this instruction himself** — `kreiser.org@me.com` → `secuura-blockchain@agentmail.to`, 2026-09-29T04:14:47Z, Message-ID `<EB856837-268F-4CC7-B167-BE74B4824634@me.com>`, subject "Audit baseline re-date". Body, verbatim:

> "Re-date GHSA-frvp-7c67-39w9 (KS-530), GHSA-mwp4-54f8-5fhr (KS-729), GHSA-wrjc-x8rr-h8h6 and GHSA-337j-9hxr-rhxg (KS-528) to 2026-10-09. The real fixes stay on those tickets."

**Authorship was verified at the raw header level before any edit**, because a relay is not his mail and does not license a baseline change:

```
Authentication-Results: amazonses.com; spf=pass (spfCheck: domain of _spf.icloud.com
designates 57.103.78.55 as permitted sender) client-ip=57.103.78.55;
envelope-from=kreiser.org@me.com; helo=outbound.st.icloud.com;
dkim=pass header.i=@me.com; dmarc=pass header.from=me.com;
```

Both DKIM and DMARC are **aligned to me.com**, which is the check that matters — a summary `dmarc: pass` alone could be aligned to another domain.

## The change: four rows, two fields each

| advisory | package | ticket | before | after |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GHSA-frvp-7c67-39w9` | @hono/node-server | KS-530 | 2026-09-30 | **2026-10-09** |
| `GHSA-mwp4-54f8-5fhr` | ip-address | KS-729 | 2026-09-30 | **2026-10-09** |
| `GHSA-wrjc-x8rr-h8h6` | react-router | KS-528 | 2026-10-02 | **2026-10-09** |
| `GHSA-337j-9hxr-rhxg` | react-router | KS-528 | 2026-10-02 | **2026-10-09** |

`expires` and `reason` only. **Asserted field by field rather than read off the diff:** exactly those four rows differ; on each, exactly those two fields differ; row count 25 before and 25 after; top-level keys unchanged. The file is re-serialised with formatting proved byte-identical on a round trip *before* the edit, which is why the diff is **8 insertions and 8 deletions** and carries nothing incidental.

**This is a date change only.** Every advisory is still live, every exception is still temporary, and the real fix stays on KS-530, KS-729 and KS-528.

`GHSA-jjmj-jmhj-qwj2`: **not re-dated** — removed from the baseline by #1214 (`ba4016fb8`), absent at develop.

## Test Evidence

**Touched:** `Blockchain/Dev/scripts/audit/audit-baseline.json` (1 file, +8/−8). No code, no manifest, no lockfile.

**Frozen-clock proof.** There is no clock seam in the gate — `utcToday()` is `new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)` and nothing overrides it, deliberately — and `faketime` is not installed on this host. So the clock is frozen in a `node --import` preload and the **real** `audit-gate.mjs` and `audit-locks.mjs` run unmodified underneath it. The whole leg runs; it is not a stubbed predicate. The preload announces itself on stderr, **refuses** when the clock is unset and when it is not a date, and a positive arm proves it actually moves `utcToday()`.

Measured against the post-merge develop `2cb858335472`:

| leg | baseline | clock | rc | lapsed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6 | develop's (the committed blob) | 2026-09-30T00:01Z | **1** | 1 — `GHSA-frvp-7c67-39w9`, KS-530, "expired 2026-09-30" |
| 6 | this PR's | 2026-09-30T00:01Z | **0** | **0** |
| 6 | this PR's | 2026-10-10T00:01Z (control) | 1 | 3, all "expired 2026-10-09" |
| 7 | develop's / this PR's / 2026-10-10 | | | 0 / 0 / 2 |

**Ran, at the real clock on this head:** `audit-gate.mjs` **rc 0**, `audit-locks.mjs` **rc 0**.

**Push preflight: 12 of 15 legs ran, 3 skipped (legs 3, 4 and 8 — local stack not up), nothing failed.** 12/15 is not a pass and is not quoted as one. Both audit legs passed inside the hook: leg 6 `audit-gate: 23 distinct advisories reported, 25 baselined. OK — no advisories outside the triaged baseline.`; leg 7 `1612 distinct packages pinned — 18 advisories match, 18 already baselined. OK`.

**Rebase evidence:** this branch was cut at `8af6ab82` and rebased onto `2cb858335472` after #1339 merged. The diff is **byte-identical before and after** — same 11,037 bytes, same sha256, `cmp` rc 0 — with patch-id agreeing as corroboration only. (`patch-id` normalises whitespace and cannot see a whitespace-only change; measured four ways, so `cmp` is the load-bearing half.)

**NOT run:** no built images, no local stack, no live sweep. No service code is touched by this change.

## Not covered

- Leg 6 prints a CLEANUP advising removal of two now-stale rows (`GHSA-v2v4-37r5-5v8g` and `GHSA-mwp4-54f8-5fhr`, both ip-address, the latter cleared by #1339's bump). **This PR edits no row beyond the four Kam named**; that removal is a separate follow-up.
- After #1339, `GHSA-mwp4-54f8-5fhr` is no longer *reported*, so it cannot lapse regardless of its date. Its re-date is therefore harmless but inert at this head — included because Kam named it.

Refs KS-530
Refs KS-729
Refs KS-528
